effects.instruction: Narrator only, the Sports Festival day runs on a real schedule: opening ceremony at 9:00; the obstacle race about 9:30 to 10:30; the cavalry battle about 11:00 to 12:00; the lunch break 12:00 to 13:00; then recreational games and the one-on-one tournament from about 13:30 into the evening, the final last. Each event takes the real time it needs: stamp story times to match this schedule (no event ends minutes after it starts), never call lunch before noon, and never move the time past the event still being played.
